name: interactive-grid-pattern

frames.best_why: Several cells along a diagonal are lit by the passing cursor, showing the hover trail.

tagline: A faint square grid lights up the cell under the pointer.
summary: An SVG grid of small square cells that fills the one you hover with a soft grey wash, then fades it out slowly, leaving a short trail as the pointer moves.
appearance: A dark field of small square cells outlined in faint grey, tiled evenly across the stage. A radial fade darkens the edges so the grid reads most clearly near the centre.
behaviour: Squares under the pointer light up almost at once, then fade back over about a second while the cursor moves on, which leaves a brief diagonal trail of lit cells.
search_phrases: grid of squares that react to mouse
use_when: A dark hero or section needs a quiet technical texture that answers the cursor.
avoid_when: Bright screens: the grid is so low-contrast it nearly vanishes.
customise: Cell size and grid count are props, and classes on the cells let you recolour the stroke and hover fill.
weight_why: An SVG of a few hundred rectangles with CSS fill transitions; idle until hover.

a11y.note: Hover only: cells cannot be highlighted from the keyboard, and the grid carries no text or labels.

issues: The grid is so low-contrast it almost disappears on dark screens.
polish_why: Clean even grid and a subtle hover wash, but the contrast is too faint to read.
title: Interactive Grid Pattern
